title: Read Discussions through the undocumented REST route, pinned by tests
body:
GitHub answers `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/discussions` over REST, with the `discussions=read` permission, although the route is not in its published API description. Others report that `GET …/discussions/{number}` and `…/comments` work too. Writing through it does not work: `POST` answers `404` (see #160).

A cloud session can therefore *read* Discussions, while writing goes through the notes branch and Actions. The domain model could read them: models for a discussion, a comment and a category, the routes, and a reader. Tests would pin the undocumented shape with recorded answers, and a live check, skipped in CI, would notice when GitHub changes it.

What would use it: #170's session log (finding the pinned log discussion), an `idea list`, and a session checking for an existing idea before posting another.

This is also the first idea posted through `idea file`, as the live check of #160.

Made with AI assistance
